# Pull request charter template

Item 1 of the owner-ratified review-convergence amendment says when a
pull request needs a charter, what the charter states, and which clauses
are always on. Its text is quoted in one place only, in
[`docs/HITL-RULE.md`](../HITL-RULE.md#amendment-2026-09-23-review-convergence).
Read it there. This template deliberately does not copy it, so there is
no second copy to drift.

Copy the block below into the pull request body before round 1 and fill
in each field. The blocking bar must include item 1's always-on clauses,
as listed there. The round budget follows item 3.

```markdown
## Charter

- **Goal:**
- **Adversary:**
- **Non-goals:**
- **Done:**
- **Blocking bar:**
- **Round budget:**
```
